frame: local metres: x = easting - E0, z = -(northing - N0), y up

sources.elevation: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (ESA, 2011-2015 radar), surface model; ground estimated by subtracting 0.7 x local canopy height
sources.canopy: Meta & WRI global canopy height map, 1 m (Tolan et al. 2024, imagery 2009-2020)
sources.context: Overture Maps 2026-09-23.1 (roads and buildings from OpenStreetMap, Google, Microsoft; places from Meta and Microsoft)
